objective: Resolve the declared training-duration, codec composition, real-model quality and serving-cost questions with complete finite comparisons; publish outcomes including losing methods

long_training.source: All 36 completed tree-node trajectories, all 3 recorded durations: 108 actual trained checkpoints
long_training.corpus: Cached SHA256-verified enwik8; preserve original first 160k training tokens
long_training.split_rule: Original tokenization; no OOV gaps closed; all registered-target context pairs; 5 negatives at frequency exponent .5
long_training.candidate_grid: Original complete 204-candidate grid plus 57 losslessly packed FAISS-code candidates; 261 per checkpoint, 28188 total
long_training.composition: For every one of the 19 FAISS codecs: native original-order direct codes, native DATrie-order direct codes, native original-order encoded-byte-dedup codes
long_training.training_choice: Validation alone may additionally choose duration and initialization within a fixed convention/order/seed. Retain every fixed-duration result and compare absolute source loss; test never chooses a duration

llm.source: All six completed exact-key 20877-edit Qwen3-0.6B/Qwen3.5-4B checkpoints; seeds 3, 7, 11; frozen original backbones
llm.task: All official MultiCounterFact rewrite, paraphrase and neighborhood choices, with original masked target scoring and tokenizer
llm.selection: Only official modulo-10 calibration cases qualify/select storage; remaining test cases audit frozen names. Source checkpoint/final epoch stays fixed
llm.fp32_model_contract: Original trained nonrow weights, canonical key dictionary, sentinels and never-addressed padding remain unchanged
llm.candidate_grid: Same raw/native/constant/tree and 19 direct/dedup codecs, plus 57 native-code compositions; 261 per model, 1566 total. Dimension-compatible PQ/OPQ replacements are declared explicitly
llm.tree_keys: Original per-head canonical token strings; preserve head boundaries. Any absent cross-order containment is measured as absent, not manufactured by relabeling rows
llm.independent_control_schedule: Same 20877 rewrite inputs, seeds, fixed 20 epochs, batch 8, frozen base, optimizer and nonrow learning rate as the exact-key source. Head constants initialize from exact source initialization means; adapter matches complete trainable branch budget
llm.gate: Source minus candidate pooled calibration harmonic score <= budget AND each ES/PS/NS decline <= budget. Audit all four metrics and paired seed/case intervals on test without reselecting
llm.quality_reuse: Only verified identical complete decoded row bytes with unchanged nonrow/base weights and execution schedule may reuse an evaluated model's scores. Every candidate stays in the ledger; reused quality points retain the evaluated source and hashes. Reopen actual reader and audit full model requests before reuse
llm.cache_contract: Hashed exact original prefix caches may accelerate quality only after complete input/weight/coverage validation. Timed serving runs full prefixes and decode; prefix caching is excluded from model-latency claims

serving.bytes: Every required row/code/codebook, scale, forwarding map, vocabulary/key registry, nonrow weight, recipe and metadata file. Record shared base bytes separately and add them for total model capacity
serving.cpu_query: Complete original-key/ID to final vectors and row-only replay separately; fresh processes, independent calibration/test traces, first-query and warm samples, load time, RSS/RssAnon/RssFile, construction peak and scratch files
serving.gpu_query: GPU source/dense, raw mmap, standalone FAISS and native candidates; same complete prompts, same row lookup and host-to-device contract, same batches. Require no external GPU compute processes before/during/after timing. Record first request, prefill, sequential decode, transfer/staging, CUDA allocated/reserved/peak and host RSS
serving.timing_rule: Quality runs may share host resources. Final CPU and GPU timings follow builders/trainers/evaluators and run serially with recorded contention. Any new competing training/evaluation process is preserved; only user-confirmed occupancy programs may be ended

release_gates: all requested candidates and controls accounted for
all original-ID code/row reopening checks passed
all fresh final timings finished or documented failed
complete immutable raw evidence published with hashes
claim_rule: Finite empirical conclusions only; change or withdraw a contradicted claim instead of dropping its control. Byte-preserving code compression inherits the existing codec's approximation. Task-quality, CPU/GPU capacity and query speed are independently measured
